newsitem.title: JAPAN: EPA says Japan consumption recovering slowly - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: EPA says Japan consumption recovering slowly - Jiji.

text.p: Japanese consumption is continuing to recover gradually despite weak household spending data for September, Economic Planning Agency vice minister Shimpei Nukaya was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Friday.

Asked about a 4.4 percent decline in September household spending in real terms, shown in data announced on Thursday, Nukaya was quoted as saying: "Tokyo department sales in October were not so bad, so there is no need to change our judgement that consumption is gradually recovering."
"But the recovery is still gradual, so we need to watch over future developments," Nukaya said.
Jiji also said Nukaya indicated that Japan will make a decision on whether to continue special income tax cuts around the middle of December.

"We will discuss the economic outlook for next fiscal year after the release of July-September GDP data in December. I don't think we will reach a conclusion (on special income tax cuts) before that," Nukaya was quoted as saying.
